interpretation: The stencil has low arithmetic intensity and may be memory-bandwidth limited at native-kernel level. These end-to-end Python timings also include process and synchronization overhead; they do not establish a DRAM bottleneck.
traffic_notes: 48 bytes counts five loads and one store at source level. 16 bytes assumes ideal spatial reuse with one input read and one output write. Neither is measured DRAM traffic; NumPy temporaries, write allocation and cache reuse alter traffic.
